import { createHash, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { SignJWT, jwtVerify, type JWTPayload } from 'jose';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';

import { logger } from '../lib/logger';
import { config } from '../config';
import { UserRepository } from '../repositories/user-repository';
import { AuditLog } from '../services/audit-log';
import { RateLimiter } from '../services/rate-limiter';

const ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 900;
const REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30;
const SESSION_KEY_PREFIX = 'sess:';
const MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS = 5;
const LOCKOUT_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

export type AuthErrorCode =
  | 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS'
  | 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED'
  | 'TOKEN_EXPIRED'
  | 'TOKEN_MALFORMED'
  | 'SESSION_REVOKED';

export class AuthError extends Error {
  readonly code: AuthErrorCode;

  constructor(code: AuthErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AuthError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

export interface Session {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly issuedAt: number;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
  readonly scopes: readonly string[];
  readonly userAgent?: string;
}

export interface TokenPair {
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
  expiresIn: number;
}

export interface AuthServiceDeps {
  users: UserRepository;
  redis: Redis;
  audit: AuditLog;
  limiter: RateLimiter;
}

function constantTimeCompare(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const left = Buffer.from(a, 'utf8');
  const right = Buffer.from(b, 'utf8');
  if (left.length !== right.length) {
    return false;
  }
  return timingSafeEqual(left, right);
}

function hashRefreshToken(token: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
}

export class AuthService {
  private readonly users: UserRepository;
  private readonly redis: Redis;
  private readonly audit: AuditLog;
  private readonly limiter: RateLimiter;
  private readonly secret: Uint8Array;

  constructor(deps: AuthServiceDeps) {
    this.users = deps.users;
    this.redis = deps.redis;
    this.audit = deps.audit;
    this.limiter = deps.limiter;
    this.secret = new TextEncoder().encode(config.auth.signingSecret);
  }

  async login(email: string, password: string, userAgent?: string): Promise<TokenPair> {
    const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const allowed = await this.limiter.consume(`login:${normalized}`, MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS, LOCKOUT_WINDOW_MS);
    if (!allowed) {
      await this.audit.record('auth.login.locked', { email: normalized });
      throw new AuthError('ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'too many failed attempts, try again later');
    }

    const user = await this.users.findByEmail(normalized);
    if (!user) {
      logger.warn({ email: normalized }, 'login attempt for unknown account');
      throw new AuthError('INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'email or password is incorrect');
    }

    const derived = createHash('sha256').update(`${user.salt}:${password}`).digest('hex');
    if (!constantTimeCompare(derived, user.passwordHash)) {
      await this.audit.record('auth.login.failed', { userId: user.id });
      throw new AuthError('INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'email or password is incorrect');
    }

    await this.limiter.reset(`login:${normalized}`);
    return this.issueTokens(user.id, user.scopes, userAgent);
  }

  async issueTokens(userId: string, scopes: readonly string[], userAgent?: string): Promise<TokenPair> {
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    const sessionId = randomBytes(18).toString('base64url');

    const accessToken = await new SignJWT({ sub: userId, scopes: [...scopes], sid: sessionId })
      .setProtectedHeader({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' })
      .setIssuedAt(now)
      .setIssuer(config.auth.issuer)
      .setAudience(config.auth.audience)
      .setExpirationTime(now + ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS)
      .sign(this.secret);

    const refreshToken = randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');
    const session: Session = {
      id: sessionId,
      userId,
      issuedAt: now,
      expiresAt: now + REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS,
      scopes: [...scopes],
      userAgent,
    };

    await this.redis.set(
      `${SESSION_KEY_PREFIX}${sessionId}`,
      JSON.stringify({ ...session, refreshHash: hashRefreshToken(refreshToken) }),
      'EX',
      REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS,
    );

    await this.audit.record('auth.token.issued', { userId, sessionId });
    return { accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn: ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS };
  }

  async verify(accessToken: string): Promise<JWTPayload> {
    try {
      const { payload } = await jwtVerify(accessToken, this.secret, {
        issuer: config.auth.issuer,
        audience: config.auth.audience,
      });

      const sessionId = typeof payload.sid === 'string' ? payload.sid : '';
      const raw = await this.redis.get(`${SESSION_KEY_PREFIX}${sessionId}`);
      if (!raw) {
        throw new AuthError('SESSION_REVOKED', 'session is no longer active');
      }
      return payload;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof AuthError) {
        throw err;
      }
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      if (message.includes('exp')) {
        throw new AuthError('TOKEN_EXPIRED', 'access token has expired');
      }
      throw new AuthError('TOKEN_MALFORMED', `could not verify token: ${message}`);
    }
  }

  async revoke(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const removed = await this.redis.del(`${SESSION_KEY_PREFIX}${sessionId}`);
    logger.info({ sessionId, removed }, 'session revoked');
    await this.audit.record('auth.session.revoked', { sessionId });
  }
}
